title: Agentic Foley Control Room
description: One decision surface for deterministic baseline, agent fitting, Grafana evidence, provider execution and human approval.

panels.title: Baseline vs agent
panels.description: A safer candidate retains every accepted contact while moving true peak farther below 0 dBTP. Loudness remains an audition decision.

panels.title: Loudness safety
panels.description: Decoded exported AAC true peak. The warning band starts at -3 dBTP; 0 dBTP is unsafe.

panels.title: Maximum timing deviation
panels.description: Peak error is relative to reviewed agent anchors, not physical contact ground truth.

panels.title: Contact timing · milliseconds from reviewed anchor
panels.description: Each bar is one fitted contact. Zero is aligned; direction shows early or late placement.

targets.expr: max by(mapping_id) (max_over_time({service_name="orpheus"} | json | project_id=~"$project" | event="sound_event" | unwrap timing_error_ms [$__range]))

panels.title: Family coverage · picture seconds
panels.description: Orange bars are reviewed ranges on the picture clock. Gaps remain untouched; row labels retain accepted or rejected status.

panels.title: Run status
panels.description: A terminal session_saved or failed event closes the run. Human review is tracked separately.

panels.title: Agent decision ledger
panels.description: Discrete, timestamped evidence gates. Rows never imply that a completed step is still running.

panels.title: Provider execution
panels.description: One completed response or failure per row. elapsed_s is real request duration, not a stretched dashboard state.

panels.title: Candidate evidence
panels.description: Render, engineering measurement and acoustic review remain separate evidence records.

panels.title: Failure taxonomy
panels.description: Failed provider requests grouped by requested model.

panels.title: Tool execution
panels.description: Completed and failed tool responses, normalized at the telemetry boundary.

panels.title: Grafana MCP evidence
panels.description: Receipts prove that the agent queried project history before rendering and candidate evidence after measurement.

panels.title: Experiment history
panels.description: Immutable measurements and human decisions. Model observations remain hypotheses until reviewed.

panels.title: Grafana MCP
panels.description: Verified when the agent has completed at least one successful project-scoped Grafana evidence read.

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: Wall-clock time from deterministic baseline to the terminal session event.

panels.title: Reported cost
panels.description: Only provider-reported cost. Missing receipts are not zero cost.

panels.title: Full-movie searches
panels.description: Approved part families propagated through deterministic full-movie query-by-example search.

panels.title: Prepared movie proxy
panels.description: Read-only 720p project proxy. Open the workspace link for frame-accurate review.

panels.title: Movie waveform · picture position
panels.description: Downsampled RMS and peak evidence on the picture clock. Click through to inspect the exact moment in Orpheus.

panels.title: Movie findings
panels.description: Movie cues, approved-family searches and human decisions with exact Part links.
